account.mangroveSectionIntro: Your reviews are signed with a cryptographic keypair. You can import an existing Mangrove Reviews account to use it here, or export yours to back it up.
account.mangroveImportTitle: Sign in to existing Mangrove Reviews account
account.mangroveImportHelp: Paste the JWK private key exported from mangrove.reviews or another client. This replaces your current keypair — all new reviews will be signed with the imported identity.
account.mangroveImportWarning: Any reviews you wrote under the current keypair will become immutable (you can no longer edit or delete them from this account).
account.mangroveImportInvalidJson: Could not parse input as JSON.
account.mangroveImportFailed: Import failed. Check that this is a valid ECDSA P-256 private JWK.
account.mangroveImportLoadedBody: Choose how to protect the imported keypair on this device. Fingerprint: <fp></fp>
account.mangroveExportHelp: This is the signing keypair for your Mangrove Reviews identity. Keep it private — anyone with this key can post reviews as you.
account.mangroveExportWarning: Treat this like a password. Store it in a password manager or secure note.
account.mangroveRegenerateConfirm: This discards your current Mangrove keypair and generates a new one. Reviews signed with the old keypair will remain visible but you will no longer be able to edit or delete them. If you want to keep the old keypair, export it first.
account.mangroveRegenerateFailed: Could not generate a new keypair.
account.mangroveSetupPrompt: You haven't set up your Mangrove Reviews keypair yet. Choose how you want to protect your signing key.
account.mangroveSetupIntro: Your reviews are signed with a cryptographic keypair. Choose how the private key should be protected — this decision is independent of your OpenMapX sign-in.
account.mangrovePassphraseDifferenceTitle: This passphrase is not your account password
account.mangrovePassphraseDifferenceBody: Your OpenMapX sign-in (email, passkey, or OAuth provider) is separate from this Mangrove passphrase. Server admins can never see the Mangrove passphrase, which is what keeps your signing key private even if our database leaks.
account.mangroveModePassphraseSubtitle: Encrypt your keypair with a passphrase you'll remember. You'll enter it before signing a review (with a short grace period).
account.mangroveModePassphraseWebAuthnSubtitle: Recommended. Unlock with your device's biometric (Face ID, Touch ID, Windows Hello, security key). Passphrase remains as a backup.
account.mangroveModeUnencryptedSubtitle: Your keypair is stored in cleartext on the server. Lowest friction, but anyone with database access can sign reviews as you. Not recommended.
account.mangroveWebAuthnUnavailable: Your browser or device does not support WebAuthn PRF. Use passphrase-only for now.
account.mangroveSetupPassphraseWebAuthnTitle: Set a passphrase and register a passkey
account.mangroveLossWarningTitle: Losing your passphrase means losing control of this keypair
account.mangroveLossWarningBody: There is no password reset. If you forget the passphrase and you have no registered passkey, you can no longer edit or delete reviews signed with this keypair — they stay public but immutable. You can always start over with a fresh keypair.
account.mangrovePassphraseHelper: At least 8 characters. Use something memorable but not one of your other passwords.
account.mangrovePassphraseHelperUnlock: The passphrase you set when creating the keypair.
account.mangrovePassphraseTooShort: Passphrase must be at least 8 characters.
account.mangroveWebAuthnStepTitle: You'll be asked for a passkey next
account.mangroveWebAuthnStepBody: After you continue, your browser will prompt you to approve a passkey ceremony (Face ID, Touch ID, or security key). The passkey's PRF output derives a key that encrypts your Mangrove keypair. The passkey itself is stored on your device.
account.mangroveUnencryptedWarningBody: Without encryption, anyone with database access (admins, attackers after a leak) can sign reviews using your identity or delete your existing reviews. We recommend a passphrase.
account.mangroveUnencryptedAck: Pick this only if friction concerns outweigh security for you — for example, a personal development instance.
account.mangroveUnencryptedBadge: Not encrypted — server sees the signing key
account.mangroveUnencryptedBadgeAlertTitle: Your keypair is stored in cleartext
account.mangroveUnencryptedBadgeAlertBody: Add encryption (passphrase or passkey) to prevent server-side access. Use "Start fresh" below to switch modes.
account.mangroveAddPassphraseHelp: You can unlock with any registered method. Adding another passphrase does not replace existing methods.
account.mangroveChangePassphraseHelp: Pick a new passphrase. Your keypair itself stays the same — only the way it's locked on this server changes.
account.mangroveRemoveLastDisabled: You must keep at least one unlock method.
account.mangroveMustUnlockForChanges: Unlock your keypair to add or remove methods, or to export it.
account.mangroveUnlockIntro: Your Mangrove signing key is encrypted. Unlock it to sign a review.
account.mangroveUnlockFailed: Unlock failed. Check your passphrase or use a passkey.

settings.rememberRecentMapDataDescription: Stores recent searches, routes, place details, weather, photos, and nearby results on this device. Most entries expire within minutes to 24 hours; photo lookup caches can remain up to 7 days. This can include typed search text and precise map coordinates.
settings.clearRecentMapDataDescription: Removes persisted recent searches, routes, coordinates, and API response caches from this device.
settings.clearTilesDescription: Removes all map tiles cached on the fly. Your downloaded offline areas are kept.
settings.persistentStorageOn: Protected — the browser won't evict your downloaded areas or the offline app between sessions.
settings.persistentStorageOff: Not protected — the browser may delete cached tiles, downloaded areas, and the offline app when storage runs low. This can stop the app from opening offline.
